```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(forcats)
library(ggforce)
library(patchwork)
```

read in data
```{r}
df <- read.csv("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/bewell_taxonomy_relAbun.csv")
```

Seperate taxonomy variable by level of taxononmy
```{r}
taxa <- df %>% 
  separate(Taxonomy, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus"), "\\|")
```

# Create functions to filter, select best generalization, and plot
```{r}
get_phyl_ra <- function(exora){
  exora.phyl <- exora %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(tot.ra = sum(RelAbun),
         exo.ra = RelAbun/tot.ra) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(sample, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(ra = sum(exo.ra, na.rm = T)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
}
```

# Call functions
```{r, include=FALSE}
taxa <- taxa %>%
  filter(!is.na(Phylum))

exora.p <- get_phyl_ra(taxa)

large.phyls <- exora.p %>% 
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(median.ra = median(ra)) %>%
  arrange(desc(median.ra)) %>%
  mutate(x = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::filter(x <= 7)
large.phyls <- large.phyls$Phylum

tmp <- exora.p %>% arrange(desc(ra))
sampord.orter <- tmp$sample
```

# Join with sample data
```{r}
vars <- df %>% select(sample, variable) %>% distinct()
exora.p.hist <- vars %>%
  right_join(exora.p)
```

```{r}
exora.p.hist <- exora.p.hist %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(Phylum %in% large.phyls, Phylum, "Other"),
           Phylum = gsub("^p__", "", Phylum))
```

Get pre/post BRB
```{r}
BRB <- exora.p.hist %>%
  filter(variable == "rB" | variable == "tB")
```

Get pre/post placebo
```{r}
Plac <- exora.p.hist %>%
  filter(variable == "rP" | variable == "tP")
```


# Plot pre/post BRB
```{r}
gB <- BRB %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = ra, fill = Phylum)) +
    geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity") +
    labs(x = "", y = "") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkslateblue", "darkgoldenrod2","cornflowerblue", "darkgreen", "darkorange4","salmon2", "cornflowerblue", "deeppink4" ,"cyan4", "salmon2"), name = "Taxa") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank())  +
   facet_row(vars(variable), scales = "free_x", space = "free") 

gB
```
